description: Find which electric utilities serve a US location, with how many tariffs each has in the NREL rate database, which sectors they cover, and how many of those tariffs are still current. Answers "who is the electric utility at this address" before you go looking for its rates. Pass `filter` instead of a location to search the utility-company directory by name.

_apiKey.description: Your own free NREL API key. Optional — the shared DEMO_KEY works at a low rate limit.

filter.description: Instead of a location: case-insensitive substring to search utility names in the OpenEI directory

latitude.description: Latitude in WGS84 decimal degrees (use with longitude)

longitude.description: Longitude in WGS84 decimal degrees (use with latitude)

name: urdb_utilities_for_location
